strictSat.title: Strict validated SAT form
strictSat.note: Section counts match the digital SAT. This pass did not rebuild the form. Module 2 still has a stored easier set and a stored harder set. Some items inside the form still share a restoration-log or planner-equation frame.

actScience.title: Strict validated ACT Science form
actScience.howItSurfaces: format_version 1 stores the 40 ids in question_ids. Empty English, Math, and Reading arrays make the exam loader treat every id as Science. The section clock is the 40-minute science module.
actScience.composition: 14 data and trend questions, 15 experimental-design questions, 11 conflicting-viewpoint questions. Each answer was recomputed from the passage table or graph before insert.
